about: The evangelium of the formulary “Saint Lawrence, Martyr” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: At that time, Jesus said to His disciples: Amen, amen, I say to you: unless a grain of wheat, falling into the earth, dies, it remains by itself alone; but if it dies, it bears much fruit. Whoever loves his life will lose it, and whoever hates his life in this world guards it for eternal life. If anyone ministers to Me, let him follow Me; and where I am, there My minister also will be. If anyone ministers to Me, My Father will honor him.
